title_ar: إعلام عام إلى جميع المترشحين و الناخبين
title_en: A General Notice to All Candidates and Voters
body_ar:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

الحمد لله و كفى و سلام على عباده الذين اصطفى

أما بعد فهذا إعلام عام إلى جميع المترشحين و الناخبين أن التزوير في الانتخابات من شهادة الزور التي هي من أكبر الكبائر حيث عدها الله تعالى مع الشرك به فقال : { فَاجْتَنِبُوا الرِّجْسَ مِنَ الْأَوْثَانِ وَاجْتَنِبُوا قَوْلَ الزُّور حُنَفَاءَ لِلَّهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِ}

وعدها النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم من أكبر الكبائر كما في حديث أبي بكرة رضي الله عنه قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ( " ألا أنبئكم بأكبر الكبائر عند الله " قالوا : بلى يا رسول الله قال :" الشرك بالله و عقوق الوالدين و كان متكئا فجلس فقال : ألا و قول الزور ألا و شهادة الزور" فما زال يكررها حتى قلنا ليته سكت) متفق عليه و في لفظ " وقتل النفس التي حرم الله إلا بالحق " بدل و عقوق الوالدين "

كما أن في التزوير كبيرة أخرى حين يصوت الشخص باسم غيره هي انتساب الرجل إلى غير أبيه ، ففي حديث سعد بن أبي وقاص رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال : " من ادعى إلى غير أبيه وهو يعلم أنه غير أبيه فالجنة عليه حرام " متفق عليه، و لهذا كان التزوير منافيا للصوم لقول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم " من لم يدع قول الزور و العمل به فليس لله حاجة في أن يدع طعامه و شرابه " متفق عليه .

كما أن التصويت لمرشح على أساس مصلحة دنيوية خاصة من وظيفة أو جاه أو مال من أكبر الكبائر و أغلظها عقوبة لحديث أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم "ثَلَاثَة لا يَنْظُرُ اللهِ إلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، ولا يُزَكِّيهِمْ، وَلَهُمْ عَذَاب ألِيم: رَجُلٌ كَانَ لَهُ فَضْلُ مَاءِ بِالطرَّيقِ فَمَنَعَهُ مِنِ ابْنِ السَّبِيلِ، وَرَجُل بَايَعَ إِمَاماً لَا يُبَايِعُهُ إلَّا لِدُنيا، فَإِنْ أَعْطَاهُ مِنْهَا رَضِيَ، وِإنْ لَمْ يُعْطِهِ مِنْهَا سَخِطَ، وَرَجُل أقامَ سِلْعَتَهُ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ، فَقَالَ: وَاللهِ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُهُ لَقَدْ أعطَيْتُ بِهَا كَذَا أَو كَذَا، فَصَدَّقَهُ رَجُل، ثُمَّ قَرَأ هَذِهِ الآيَةِ (الَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ وَأَيْمَانِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا أُولَٰئِكَ لَا خَلَاقَ لَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ وَلَا يَنظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ ".

كما أن التصويت لمرشح يعلمُ الناخبُ أن في المرشحين من هو أتقى منه و أصلح - سواء كان ذلك على المستوى الفردي أو الحزبي - من الخيانة التي هي من أكبر الكبائر ففي حديث ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسولُ الله صلى الله عليه وسلم " من استعمل رجلا من عصابة و فيهم من هو أرضى لله منه فقد خان الله و رسوله و المؤمنين"

أخرجه الحاكم في المستدرك و قال : صحيح الإسناد ويشهد له حديث أبي بكر رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : " من ولي من أمر المسلمين شيئا فأمر عليهم أحدا محاباة فعليه لعنة الله لا يقبل الله منه صرفا و لا عدلا حتى يدخله جهنم " أخرجه الحاكم و قال صحيح الإسناد ورواه أحمد

نسأل الله أن يوفق الجميع لما يحب و يرضى

كتبه محمد الحسن الددو

كان الله له و لأوليائه وليا و نصيرا
body_en:
In the name of God, the Merciful, the Compassionate.

Praise be to God, and He suffices; and peace be upon His servants whom He has chosen.

To proceed: this is a general notice to all candidates and voters, that fraud in elections is a form of false witness, which is among the gravest of the major sins, in that God the Exalted counted it together with associating partners with Him, saying: {So shun the abomination of idols, and shun false speech, turning to God alone, not associating anything with Him}.

And the Prophet, God bless him and grant him peace, counted it among the gravest of the major sins, as in the hadith of Abu Bakrah (may God be pleased with him), who said: The Messenger of God, God bless him and grant him peace, said: 'Shall I not tell you of the gravest of the major sins in God's sight?' They said: Yes indeed, Messenger of God. He said: 'Associating partners with God, and disobedience to one's parents.' He had been reclining, and he sat up and said: 'Beware — and false speech! Beware — and false witness!' And he kept repeating it until we said: If only he would stop. Agreed upon. And in one wording, 'and killing the soul that God has forbidden, save by right' stands in place of 'and disobedience to one's parents'.

Furthermore, there is in this fraud another major sin, when a person votes under another's name: that is a man's claiming descent from someone other than his father. In the hadith of Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (may God be pleased with him), the Prophet, God bless him and grant him peace, said: 'Whoever claims descent from someone other than his father, knowing that he is not his father, Paradise is forbidden to him.' Agreed upon. And for this reason fraud is incompatible with fasting, because of the saying of the Prophet, God bless him and grant him peace: 'Whoever does not forsake false speech and acting upon it, God has no need of his forsaking his food and his drink.' Agreed upon.

Furthermore, voting for a candidate on the basis of a particular worldly interest — a post, or standing, or money — is among the gravest of the major sins and the severest of them in punishment, because of the hadith of Abu Hurayrah (may God be pleased with him), who said: The Messenger of God, God bless him and grant him peace, said: 'Three at whom God will not look on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them, and theirs is a painful punishment: a man who had surplus water by the road and withheld it from the traveller; a man who pledged allegiance to a leader, pledging it to him only for the sake of this world, so that if he gives him something of it he is content, and if he does not give him anything of it he is displeased; and a man who set out his goods for sale after the afternoon prayer and said, By God, besides whom there is no god, I was offered such and such for it — and a man believed him.' Then he recited this verse: {Those who sell God's covenant and their own oaths for a small price — those will have no share in the Hereafter; God will not speak to them, nor look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor purify them; and theirs is a painful punishment}.

Furthermore, voting for a candidate when the voter knows that among the candidates there is one more God-conscious and more upright than he — whether that be at the level of the individual or of the party — is a form of betrayal, which is among the gravest of the major sins. In the hadith of Ibn Abbas (may God be pleased with them both), he said: The Messenger of God, God bless him and grant him peace, said: 'Whoever appoints a man from a group when there is among them one more pleasing to God than he, has betrayed God, and His Messenger, and the believers.'

Al-Hakim narrated it in al-Mustadrak and said: its chain is sound. Supporting it is the hadith of Abu Bakr (may God be pleased with him), who said: The Messenger of God, God bless him and grant him peace, said: 'Whoever is given charge of any of the affairs of the Muslims and then sets someone over them out of favouritism, upon him is the curse of God; God will accept from him neither ṣarf nor ʿadl until He admits him to Hell.' Al-Hakim narrated it and said: its chain is sound; and Ahmad also related it.

We ask God to grant all success in what He loves and is pleased with.

Written by Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew.

May God be a protector and a helper to him and to His friends.

flags.arabic: التزوير في الانتخابات من شهادة الزور التي هي من أكبر الكبائر ... التصويت لمرشح ... من الخيانة
flags.context: the four rulings that make up the notice
options: publish as a faithful translation of a signed public ruling on electoral conduct
publish with a standing editorial note on the context
flags.note: EDITORIALLY SENSITIVE — the most exposed record in this slice. This is a signed public ruling by the Sheikh, issued in the run-up to the Mauritanian elections of 2018, holding that (i) electoral fraud is false witness, among the gravest major sins; (ii) voting under another's name is additionally the sin of claiming false descent; (iii) voting for a candidate for a private worldly benefit is among the gravest major sins and the severest in punishment; and (iv) voting for a candidate while knowing a more God-conscious and upright candidate exists — at the individual OR the party level — is betrayal. In English, published without its date and setting, (iii) and (iv) read as a ruling on how any Muslim anywhere must vote, and could be turned against named parties or candidates in a live election. The translation is faithful — nothing softened, nothing strengthened — and the decision on whether and how to publish belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office.

flags.arabic: لا يقبل الله منه صرفا و لا عدلا
flags.context: the hadith of Abu Bakr on appointing out of favouritism
options: neither an obligatory act nor a voluntary one
neither a substitute nor an equivalent
flags.note: The pair ṣarf/ʿadl is disputed among the early authorities: obligatory versus supererogatory works, or repentance versus ransom, or a substitute versus an equivalent. Since the Sheikh gives no gloss, none is imposed; the terms are carried over transliterated so that the ambiguity of the Arabic survives, and the reviewing scholar should choose. A confident English rendering here would be supplying an interpretation the text does not give.

flags.arabic: { فَاجْتَنِبُوا الرِّجْسَ مِنَ الْأَوْثَانِ وَاجْتَنِبُوا قَوْلَ الزُّور حُنَفَاءَ لِلَّهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِ}
flags.context: the Qur'anic proof cited for the gravity of false speech
flags.note: The quotation crosses a verse boundary: 'فاجتنبوا الرجس من الأوثان واجتنبوا قول الزور' ends verse 30 and 'حنفاء لله غير مشركين به' opens verse 31. The source gives no reference and the English adds none in the body. The display will need one, and it must show the span, not a single verse. Note also that 'الزُّور' is printed without its final case vowel in the source.

flags.arabic: حديث أبي بكر رضي الله عنه
flags.context: the attribution of the second of the two hadiths on appointment
options: possibly Abu Bakrah, the narrator of the hadith cited earlier in the notice
flags.note: Recorded, not corrected (house rule 11). The report about appointing out of favouritism is more commonly cited from Ibn Abbas or from the Prophet without a Companion named; the notice attributes it to Abu Bakr. Since the same notice earlier cites Abu Bakrah, a confusion of the two names is possible. The attribution has been translated exactly as the Sheikh gives it, and no grading has been added or dropped (style guide section 4).

translator_notes: This is a text written and signed by the Sheikh himself ('كتبه محمد الحسن الددو'), not a report about him. Everything in it is his.

The hadith gradings are given exactly as the Sheikh gives them: 'متفق عليه' as 'agreed upon' (al-Bukhari and Muslim), and al-Hakim's 'صحيح الإسناد' as 'its chain is sound'. No grading has been added and none dropped.
Qur'anic renderings in this corpus are interpretive and are not a substitute for the Arabic.

SOURCE DEFECTS preserved in body_ar: several misplaced or missing case endings and diacritics in the hadith of Abu Hurayrah ('بِالطرَّيقِ', 'عَذَاب ألِيم', 'وِإنْ'); an unclosed parenthesis and an unbalanced quotation mark around the Qur'anic verse at the end of that hadith; an unbalanced quotation mark at the end of the hadith of Abu Bakrah.
'أتقى' rendered 'more God-conscious', following the glossary's rendering of taqwā.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date, not necessarily the date the notice was written; the notice itself carries no date.
